name: Annotate Celltype Scrna
description: Annotate cell types based on gene markers and transferred labels using LLM. After leiden clustering, annotate clusters using differentially expressed genes and optionally incorporate transferred label
detailed_description: Annotate cell types based on gene markers and transferred labels using LLM. After leiden clustering, annotate clusters using differentially expressed genes and optionally incorporate transferred labels from reference datasets.
when_to_use: When you need annotate celltype scRNA analysis

parameters.adata_filename: [Required] Name of the AnnData file containing scRNA-seq data (str)
parameters.data_info: [Required] Information about the scRNA-seq data (e.g., "homo sapiens, brain tissue, normal") (str)
parameters.cluster: [Optional] Clustering method to use for cell type annotation (default: leiden)
parameters.llm: [Optional] Language model instance for cell type prediction (default: claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022)
parameters.composition: [Optional] Transferred cell type composition for each cluster

proven_params.params: Leiden res=0.6 (18 clusters), FindAllMarkers, KB marker scoring (14 cell type panels), human skeletal muscle markers
